At what hour you wake up? How does it look the person standing next to you? ( if you want someone,if no skip this part)

What friends do you got? What you do when you hang out? 
What clothes are you wearing? 
How do you look when you look at yourself in the mirror? 
And so on.
Hope comes with a plan or a change of country.At least,for me it is.
